Name: Animated Butterfly and Mushroom Dig Spots
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mjbfye.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]
Just a little mod that changes the dig spots into colorful mushrooms with a pastel butterfly. The butterfly is animated,
and the colors of both the shrooms and the butterflies are seasonal.




[img]https://i.imgur.com/wvlMKlE.png[/img]﻿

Just extract the file and move the folder "[CP] Luny's Mushroom Dig Spots" to your StardewValley/Mods folder.



Thanks for taking a look at my mods! („• ᴗ •„)


[img]https://i.imgur.com/fOgeWvr.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
